rpghealthbar.config.title: RPG Health Bar
rpghealthbar.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off.
rpghealthbar.config.enabled.tooltip.on: the RPG bars replace the vanilla hearts.
rpghealthbar.config.enabled.tooltip.off: the HUD is fully vanilla again, including your desired mana bar. Your settings and positions are kept.
rpghealthbar.config.unsaved.title: Unsaved Changes
rpghealthbar.config.unsaved.message: You have unsaved changes. Would you like to save them?
rpghealthbar.config.reset.title: Reset to Defaults
rpghealthbar.config.reset.message: Are you sure you want to reset every setting to its default? This also puts the HUD back above the hotbar and the item name at vanilla's height.
rpghealthbar.config.compat.none: None - you have all correct dependencies
rpghealthbar.config.compat.failed: %s support is off: this version couldn't be read
rpghealthbar.config.compat.wheelFailed: Spell cost preview is off: this Iron's version couldn't be read
rpghealthbar.config.compat.unifiedMana: Seeing two mana bars with Iron's and Confluence? Confluence's unified mana is off, so Iron's and Confluence each keep their own. For one shared bar, turn on convertIronsSpellMana in config/confluence-common.toml (on a server, in the server's config).
rpghealthbar.config.compat.arsUnifiedMan: Confluence has built-in Ars compatibility (Confluence 1.1.4+). For one shared bar, turn on convertArsNouveauMana in config/confluence-common.toml (on a server, in the server's config): Ars's spells then use Confluence's mana.
rpghealthbar.config.compat.arsNegativeMa: Confluence's max mana is %s: a Confluence bug with Ars installed. Confluence adds Ars's max mana to its own (even with convertArsNouveauMana off) and counted it before Ars had set it.
rpghealthbar.config.compat.noUnifiedMana: %s and %s don't include options for unified mana, so each keeps its own bar. Compatibility mods that merge them exist, but RPG Health Bar doesn't account for them, and with one installed the mana bars may behave unexpectedly.
rpghealthbar.config.preview.tooltip.on:
Preview: On
Shows the HUD on the left, as these settings draw it at its default spot. Click to hide it. It's left out when the window is too narrow.
rpghealthbar.config.preview.tooltip.off:
Preview: Off
Click to show the HUD on the left, as these settings draw it at its default spot. It needs a wide enough window.
rpghealthbar.config.airPosition.tooltip: Where the air bubbles and mount health go, relative to hunger.
stacked above the hunger icons or bar, like vanilla.
stacked under the hunger icons or bar. Useful when health or mana sit above hunger.
rpghealthbar.config.editMode.tooltip: How the health, mana and XP bars' widths are set.
rpghealthbar.config.editMode.tooltip.sim: simple preset options, like full or half width bars.
rpghealthbar.config.editMode.tooltip.adv: the freedom to set the width of the health, mana and XP bars to whatever you like, by dragging their ends in the HUD Editor.
rpghealthbar.config.editInHudEditor.tool: Drag its ends in the HUD Editor to resize it.
rpghealthbar.config.xpWidth.tooltip: How long the XP bar is, a cell at a time.
rpghealthbar.config.xpBar.tooltip: Whether the XP bar and its level number show.
rpghealthbar.config.xpBar.tooltip.hidden: no XP bar or level. The jump bar still shows while riding a horse.
rpghealthbar.edit.title: HUD Editor
rpghealthbar.edit.hint.resize: Drag a bar's end to resize it; the XP bar resizes a cell at a time.
rpghealthbar.edit.hint: Drag the HUD to move it. Arrow keys nudge (Shift: 10px).
rpghealthbar.config.healthUnit.tooltip: Unit for the numbers on the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.absorptionDisplay.to: How absorption (golden hearts) is shown. Example: 16 HP of health, 4 HP of absorption (2 golden hearts), 20 HP max.
rpghealthbar.config.moveHud.tooltip: Move the entire HUD as one, or move its individual pieces.
rpghealthbar.config.moveHud.tooltip.adva: In %s you can drag a bar's ends to resize it.
rpghealthbar.config.armorMode.tooltip.va: what the game normally shows. This will be the vanilla armor icons, or redrawn ones if another mod does so.
rpghealthbar.config.armorMode.tooltip.ba: a white bar, half the width of the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.hungerMode.tooltip.v: what the game normally shows. This will be the vanilla hunger icons, or redrawn ones if another mod does so.
rpghealthbar.config.hungerMode.tooltip.b: an orange bar, half the width of the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.healthUnit.tooltip.h: health points, 20 for a full vanilla health bar.
HP divided by 2, so 10 for a full vanilla health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.absorptionDisplay.to: health alone, 16/20, with the absorption, +4, at the bar's right end.
rpghealthbar.config.healthText.tooltip: Where the numbers (e.g. 16+4/20) go on the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.healthText.tooltip.l: at the left end of the bar.
rpghealthbar.config.manaText.tooltip: Where the numbers (e.g. 60/100) go on Iron's mana bar.
rpghealthbar.config.manaText.tooltip.lef: at the left end of the bar.
rpghealthbar.config.levelText.tooltip: Where the XP level's number goes on the XP bar.
rpghealthbar.config.levelText.tooltip.le: at the left end of the bar.
rpghealthbar.config.healthSize.tooltip: How wide the health bar is.
rpghealthbar.config.healthSize.tooltip.h: half as wide, like the armor and hunger bars.
rpghealthbar.config.manaSize.tooltip: How wide Iron's mana bar is (only shown with Iron's).
rpghealthbar.config.manaSize.tooltip.hal: half as wide, like the armor and hunger bars.
rpghealthbar.config.confluenceManaText.t: Where the numbers (e.g. 20/20) go on Confluence's mana bar.
at the left end of the bar.
rpghealthbar.config.confluenceManaSize.t: How wide Confluence's mana bar is.
half as wide, like the armor and hunger bars.
rpghealthbar.config.arsManaText.tooltip: Where the numbers (e.g. 20/20) go on Ars's mana bar.
at the left end of the bar.
rpghealthbar.config.arsManaSize.tooltip: How wide Ars's mana bar is.
half as wide, like the armor and hunger bars.
rpghealthbar.config.itemNameOffset.toolt: Moves the held item's name up (+) or down (-), in pixels, when the HUD isn't above the hotbar.
leaves room for hotbar mods, like extra hotbars.
brings it down, to right above the hotbar at the value shown below. Looks better without such mods.
rpghealthbar.config.itemName.tooltip: Set how high the held item's name sits, with a preview.
rpghealthbar.itemName.title: Item Name Height
rpghealthbar.itemName.overlap: It never goes onto the HUD or the hotbar; it stops just above them.
rpghealthbar.edit.hint.one: Drag a piece to move it on its own. Arrow keys nudge it (Shift: 10px).
rpghealthbar.config.moveMode.tooltip.all: The whole HUD, with every piece keeping its place in it.
rpghealthbar.config.moveMode.tooltip.one: One piece on its own: armor, hunger, health, a mana bar, or the XP bar with the level. Air bubbles and mount health move with hunger.
